summary: Deallocates the score database: first deallocates the score slot referenced by dword_7C7030, then frees the base score-database block at dword_7C5728 if it is non-null. Returns the free wrapper's result when the base block was freed, otherwise returns 0.

local_names.result: return value register (eax) carrying the FreeWrapper result or 0

operations.description: Calls ScoreSlotDeallocator with dword_7C7030 as the slot argument.
Loads dword_7C5728 into the result value so the null path returns 0.
Checks dword_7C5728 for non-null; only a non-null base score-database pointer proceeds to the free call.
Calls FreeWrapper_7bcf with dword_7C5728 as the block to free, passing it as an LPVOID.
Returns the FreeWrapper_7bcf result when the base block was freed, otherwise returns the previously loaded 0 value.

unresolved: The semantic identity of dword_7C5728 as the base score-database block and dword_7C7030 as the score slot handle is carried from the existing skeleton analysis (DERIVED) and is not provable from the raw source alone.
dword_7C7030 is read but never null-checked before being passed to ScoreSlotDeallocator; whether ScoreSlotDeallocator tolerates a null handle is unverified.
The caller-side meaning of the returned free result (0 or FreeWrapper result) is unknown; the packet lists no callers.
